steps.note: A fresh clone has no .env, so make up copies the example first: key names, with development defaults.

output: for p in sdk-dotnet/Endgame.AppKit sdk-dotnet/Endgame.AppKit.Testing dev/Endgame.AppKit.DevPlatform; do \
MSBuildEnableWorkloadResolver=false DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 dotnet pack $p -c Release --nologo || exit 1; done
steps.note: make up runs this itself: Dock's image carries the app kit's template.
--wait returns only when every service is healthy; then http://localhost:8095/ serves the console.
